name: Phase 5E Entity and Node Identity Semantics

node_attributes.id: Canonical string identifier (e.g., UUID or deterministic hash). Unique per bank or consortium.
node_attributes.bank_id: Tenant identifier establishing institutional data ownership boundary.
node_attributes.entity_type: Domain entity type enumeration: customer, merchant, account, device, ip_address, card, transaction.
node_attributes.risk_level: Ordinal classification: critical, high, medium, low, minimal.
node_attributes.privacy_id: Type-salted HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymized token used for cross-bank matching without raw PII transmission.
node_attributes.display_label: Human-readable label sanitized to prevent PII exposure (e.g., 'Cust ***1234').
node_attributes.alert_count: Integer count of historical fraud alerts attributed to this entity.
node_attributes.first_seen: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of first observed activity.
node_attributes.last_seen: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of most recent observed activity.

relationship_semantics.relationship_type: Domain edge enumeration: owns, uses, transacts_with, shares_device, shares_ip, linked_alert, same_entity.
relationship_semantics.evidence: Structured evidence dictionary containing transaction amounts, timestamps, or device fingerprints.
relationship_semantics.created_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of relationship formation.

cross_bank_identity_resolution.mechanism: MinHash LSH Fuzzy Private Set Intersection (PSI)
cross_bank_identity_resolution.pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 with consortium salt and entity-type domain separator
cross_bank_identity_resolution.privacy_guarantee: Zero raw PII transmission; banks exchange only cryptographic digests and minhash sketches
cross_bank_identity_resolution.multi_tenant_isolation: Strict tenant filtering on local graphs; cross-bank links established only via authorized PSI consensus or explicit consortium alert links.
